name: Sovryn Dollar
oneLiner: DLLR is Sovryn's Rootstock dollar token backed through Mynt; minting and redemption are stopped following the November 2026 Zero halt.
collateral: Mynt claims on Sovryn Zero ZUSD and Money on Chain DOC; ZUSD token operations and balance queries are halted, leaving current whole-book reserve composition unavailable
pegMechanism: Designed for 1:1 Mynt conversion against ZUSD or DOC; both minting and redemption paths are stopped by the ZUSD halt as of the November 12, 2026 review

notices.title: Mynt minting and redemption stopped
notices.message: Reviewed November 12, 2026: the November 7 Zero emergency halt blocks Mynt conversions against both DOC and ZUSD. Pinned calls still revert. Ordinary DLLR transfers are separate; current reserve composition and recovery value are unavailable. Sovryn describes containment and recovery conditions without a reopening date. Source: https://forum.sovryn.com/t/sovryn-mitigation-and-recovery-manifest/3611
